groups.heading: Syrup
steps: Bring the water, sugar and cream of tartar to the boil. Once boiling, add the lemon juice and simmer 10 minutes.
Cool to room temperature. Pour half into a bowl set over ice to cool quickly; put the rest in the fridge.

groups.heading: Dough
steps: Sift the flour and baking powder and rub in the margarine with your fingertips.
Whisk the ½ egg into the water. Make a well in the flour, pour in the water mixture and mix to a dough. Knead until smooth.
Cover with cling film and rest at least 15 minutes, or up to 5 hours. Heat the oil to 160°C.

With an oiled rolling pin, roll the dough 5 mm thick on an oiled surface. Cut 6 x 15 cm rectangles and cut each lengthways into 3 strips, leaving one end uncut. Plait and press the ends together firmly.
Fry in batches of 6 for 6 to 7 minutes, until dark golden. Drain a few seconds on paper towel and keep the rest covered so they don't dry out.
Dip the hot koeksisters into the ice-cold syrup, lift out with a slotted spoon onto a wire rack.
The syrup warms with use, so halfway through swap to the second batch of syrup from the fridge.
